'''Lamian''' ({{zh|first=t|t=拉麵|s=拉面|p=Lāmiàn}}; 'pulled noodles') is a type of soft wheat flour handmade [[Chinese noodles|Chinese noodle]] that is particularly common in [[Northern and southern China|northern China]]. Lamian is made by twisting, stretching and folding the dough into strands, using the weight of the dough.<ref name="seventisabban" /> The length and thickness of the strands depends on the number of times the dough is folded.<ref name="seventisabban" />
